summary: Eco Wave Power filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) announcing the closing of a $4.0M registered direct offering with a single strategic institutional investor. The deal consisted of 400,000 ADSs at $10.00/ADS, a 10.7% premium to the prior close, plus warrants to purchase 300,000 ADSs at $12.00/ADS (32.9% premium) expiring June 2029. Maxim Group acted as sole placement agent. The shelf takedown was made under an effective F-3. Net proceeds will fund global project deployment and AI capabilities. This is a routine financing by a non-US issuer, not triggering a special-situations classification.
